comparison.objective: Run a two-sled ramp experiment, identify the higher-friction base, and place it on a mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Experimental setup, common-gate release, observation-based comparison, and selection.
comparison.success_condition: Two valid stopping measurements differ by over 30 mm; only the higher-friction sled is released on the mat.
comparison.reason: Tests physical experimentation and inference, not tool-mediated impact, fracture, or fragment containment.
